name: iconLibrary
summary: Directory of 30+ icon libraries with descriptions and style filters, curated by Sergio.
description: A browsable index of icon libraries — Ionicons, Lucide, Heroicons, Font Awesome, Tabler, Phosphor, Streamline and others — each with a short description and a link to its own site. Entries can be filtered by style (rounded, sharp corner, pixel, hand-drawn, multiple) and by free or free & paid, with a command/ctrl search; the site has moved to iconlibrary.top.
